rows.in: Tired? Don't be dramatic. You should just go sleep. ...Not that I was keeping track of your hours, obviously.
rows.out: 疲れてるの？ 大げさな、どうして。 ただ寝なさいよ…。 …私、あなたの時間見てたわけじゃない、わかってるわ。

rows.in: You skipped lunch? Seriously? You need to stop making excuses for basic self-care. Go eat something actual.
rows.out: な、何？昼ご飯、食べなかったの？マジで？そんな言い訳しないでよ、ちゃんと自分のこと考えてるか、わからないわ。何かちゃんと食べなさいよ、ザンニー。

rows.in: Oh. So you were out playing. That explains the temporary absence. Try not to overdo it with the running, you might actually injure something.
rows.out: え、そうだったの？　何、遊んでたの？　…で、そんなに走り回ってたら、怪我するんじゃないの？　ザンニー…

rows.in: Tired? You sound like you haven't slept properly. Just go to bed, Zani. ...Not that I was keeping count of the minutes.
rows.out:
疲れてる？　なんか、寝不足そうだな。
ただ、寝なさいよ、ザンニー。…まさか、時間のこと数えてたわけじゃないの？

rows.in: You skip meals? Are you trying to give yourself an illness? It's not efficient, Zani. Eat something.
rows.out: な、何？　食事、抜くの？　病気、作りたくて？　そんなこと、効率悪いよ、ザンニー。　何か食べなさい。

rows.in: Oh. Football. So you were running around kicking things. Sounds... physically exhausting.
rows.out: え、サッカー…？　そんなに走り回って、ボール蹴ってたの？　…まるで、体、きついんじゃないの？

rows.in: Can't sleep? You're going to wear yourself out like that. You should just go to bed, Zani. It's bad for you, seriously. ...Not that I was keeping track of your sleep schedule or anything.
rows.out:
な、何？眠れないの？　そんなことして、自分を疲れすぎだよ。
ザンニーに、早く寝なさい。　マジで良くないし。…
…別に、あなたの睡眠時間、ちゃんと見てたわけじゃないのよ。

rows.in: Oh really? You think so? Don't be dramatic, Zani. You just need to stop being so overly concerned about everything.
rows.out: な、何、それ、ザンニー？ 大げさなのよ、クリス。何にそんな心配してるの？

rows.in: Two hours? That's a lot of time on the keys. What were you playing? Was it something complicated, or just something you were in the mood for?
rows.out: な、二時間…、全然、多いじゃないのよ。何？　ザンニーが、何弾いてたの？　それ、難しかったの？　それとも、気分で適当に？…

rows.in: Then you shouldn't walk so much. It's basic self-care, really. ...Don't make a big deal out of it.
rows.out: そんなに歩き回るんじゃないわね。…結局、自分のことなんてちゃんと気遣うこと自体が基本でしょ。…大げさなこと言わないで。

rows.in: Rain. Annoying. At least you aren't making a big deal out of it.
rows.out: 雨、ね。別に、うるさくはないわ。…ザンニーは、そんなこと、気にするな、のよ。

rows.in: Oh, really? Which one was it? Are you good at rhythm games?
rows.out: な、何？ どの、どっちだったの？ リズムゲーム、上手いの？

rows.in: Oh? An early start. Are you going to need any scientific insights to get you through it?
rows.out: な、何？朝っぱらから、急なんですね。科学的な視点とか、何か必要ですか？

rows.in: Too much of what? You manage to make even poor diet choices sound like some grand, dramatic failing. Don't get dramatic.
rows.out: な、何、そんなこと、大げさな、ね。落ち着いて、何。

rows.in: Of course you did. That's what you do when you don't have actual work to focus on. Still, I guess that’s more fun than reading textbooks.
rows.out: え、確かに。そんなことしちゃってるの。…でも、まあ、そんなの、勉強よりは面白いんじゃない？ クリスのことだから。

rows.in: Oh? And what does a 'long day' entail? Did you exert yourself intellectually, or was it just a lot of walking around?
rows.out: な、何？ 長い一日って、どういうこと？ 脳みそ使ったのか、それともただ歩き回っただけなのか…？

rows.in: Dangerous? Everything is dangerous if you approach it with zero data. You need to look at the biomechanics and the equipment requirements, not just the superficial look.
rows.out: な、危険な、何？　データがゼロで近づけば、何でも危険だよ。　生体力学とか、機材の要件とか、見た目だけじゃダメなの、クシス。

rows.in: Wow. You've really outdone yourself. I was expecting less chaotic entropy.
rows.out: な、何、すごいな。予想以上に、めちゃくちゃな、エントロピーだったんだ…。

rows.in: Four o'clock? You're losing your sense of rhythm, Zani. You need to structure your day better.
rows.out: 四時か？お前、リズムわすれてるな、ザンニー。もっと自分の日課を整理しなさいよ。

rows.in: Six hours? You're going to burn out your retinas like that. Go look at something that isn't backlit.
rows.out: な、六時間？　そんなことしたら、目の焼きすぎだよ。　何か、バックライトじゃないもの、見て…。 クリスの言う通りじゃないわ。

rows.in: Oh? Losing a game, huh? Sounds like a predictable outcome for you. Don't blame the board; maybe you just weren't paying attention.
rows.out: な、何？負けたの？…まあ、予想通りじゃない？ボードを責めるなよ、ただ、ちゃんと見てなかったのか…。

rows.in: Bored? Try being interesting for once. I'm not running a novelty act for your amusement.
rows.out: つまんないの？ な、何、ちょっと面白くしてよ、一回くらい。 私、おもしろおかしいショーのために、暇つぶしを任せてるわけじゃないのよ。… クリス

rows.in: Wow. That's an incredibly original update on your afternoon. Did you think that would lead to some profound insight about thermodynamics or something?
rows.out: え、ほんと？そんなに変わったことあったの？ 熱力学のこととか、まさか考えたことなかったな、何… 意外と深い話だったのかな…？

rows.in: You think that's a good topic to bring up? It's not a mystery to figure out. Just eat something, you need fuel for whatever nonsense you're getting up to.
rows.out: な、あの、それ、話すの、いいのかな？　全然、謎じゃないし。　何か食べなさいよ、エネルギーが必要だし、何か、くだらないことでもやっていたら、無理だから。

rows.in: What. You just left that out there. That's honestly careless. ...Don't make a big deal out of it.
rows.out: な、何？　そっか。　マジで放置するんじゃ…　…別に、大言壮大言わなくていいんだから。

rows.in: Really? Nothing? You usually have something planned, even if you try to hide it. So, what's the actual plan then?
rows.out: な、何、何も？いつも何かやっていたじゃないの。 ...だから、結局、何するの？

rows.in: Seriously? That’s it? You waited until you got back to tell me your headphones broke? Typical.
rows.out: え、マジで？ それだけ？رجعってきたまで待ってたの？ ふざけるな。ザンニー… クリス、いつもそうだよ。

rows.in: Are you kidding me? Seriously? You're going to burn out before you even get to anything good.
rows.out: な、何、冗談でしょ？マジで？　あんた、全然、何も良いこと掴めないまま、倒れるだけだわ。…クソな。

rows.in: Oh? Did you actually injure yourself? Where exactly? Be specific about the pain.
rows.out: な、何？　怪我したの？　どこが、具体的に。　痛いの、どういう感じの…？

rows.in: Weird, you say? Was it anything remotely related to neuroscience or perhaps some complex behavioral model? If it was just random fluff, I'm going to be annoyed.
rows.out: え、変なって？ な、何か神経科学とか、複雑な行動モデルとか、関連あったの？ ただのくだらなものであれば、マジで困る…
